checkpointPayload.description: Discover the live WebGL 1.293 asset structure and manifests, inventory all corresponding repository assets, download/convert stale or missing assets, record provenance and audit coverage, validate and rebuild.
checkpointPayload.title: Audit and refresh assets for live game 1.293

newValue.text: Verify live 1.293 asset roots/manifests and inventory all corresponding bundled categories with explicit coverage.
Download and validate upstream assets, convert textures, update stale/missing local files and any required metadata references.
Provide reproducible version-aware audit/update tooling and provenance, including failures and unavailable upstream paths.
Run relevant tests, full checks and build, update docs and commit reviewed changes.

taskChanges.newValue: 1. Discover CDN layout from captured indexGet and existing generators; verify live 1.293 public manifests/config sources. 2. Inventory bundled heroes/titans/items and config-derived missing counterparts; build a version-aware bounded-concurrency download/convert audit with hashes and atomic writes. 3. Execute the audit, inspect changed imagery and update metadata references to converted files. 4. Document source versions, category coverage and unresolved assets. 5. Test downloader/conversion/integrity behavior and existing UI references; full tests/build, review, validate and commit.

Verified public 1.293.0/v0001/extends/icons/hero/hero_0016.img and hero/titan_160_4000.img; _new variant absent. Root directory listings forbidden; old 1.292 assets unavailable. Existing temp/splitlib is absent, so old hero/item generators cannot fully run. Awaiting optional fresh indexGet log/path from user for current splitlib catalog; proceeding with all bundled category inventory and reproducible sync tooling. Current bundle: 83 hero files, 29 titan files, 45 consumables, 47 gear, 9 scrolls. Known metadata still marks supplied hero 78 absent; update references during audit.

Live startup timeline confirms game 1.293.101 / CDN 1.293.0. Verified compressed full index MD5 c40122f2b0fb79fc5e133f9b9f9d5ee3 (17360 entries, 7746 icons) and splitlib MD5 46e298e9f4305c4264057cbeb7fbf6bd plus all archive members. Exact metadata filename mapping replaces guesses (gear 1 uses gear_6_new, hero 4/43 use variants). All 83 heroes now PNG, including Wodryn; superseded WebP mirrors removed after verification. Updated locale/names/Tower buffs and local hero/titan metadata. Added sync checksum/mapping/ZIP/retry/coverage tests; adjusted prior UI assertions tied to old avatars. Canonical workflow doc added.
